headline.purpose: App shell and major section headings.

title.purpose: Panel, table group, and dialog titles.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, compact metadata, and sparse uppercase labels.

shadows.name: panel-rest
shadows.purpose: Existing dashboard panel shadow. Prefer tonal layering for new static panels.

shadows.name: action-lift
shadows.purpose: Existing primary button emphasis. Reduce in dense regions.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Panel reveal and soft entrance easing.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One main action per region, using Quiet Orchid and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: var(--primary, #c062a8); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #c062a8) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with border-first structure and muted hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2d7fb); border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--background, #f6f1ff) 70%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #2a2148); font: 500 0.875rem/1.2 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #efe7ff); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #c062a8) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Rounded border-first field for secrets, filters, and config values.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 2.75rem; width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--input, #e2d7fb); border-radius: 1.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--background, #f6f1ff) 70%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #2a2148); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #766a98); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #c062a8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #c062a8) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Badge
components.description: Compact count, provider, and status chip with text-first meaning.
components.css: .ds-badge { min-height: 1.5rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2d7fb); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--background, #f6f1ff) 40%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #2a2148); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1.2 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Dashboard Panel
components.description: Neutral container for operational data, using border and tonal fill before shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--border, #e2d7fb); border-radius: 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card, #ffffff) 88%, transparent); color: var(--foreground, #2a2148); padding: 1.25rem; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 600; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #766a98); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Primary orientation control with active state visible through fill, weight, and label contrast.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; width: 16rem; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 2.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 0 1rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #766a98); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--muted, #efe7ff); color: var(--foreground, #2a2148); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--primary, #c062a8); color: var(--primary-foreground, #ffffff); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #c062a8) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: Rusuh's interface is an operator surface, not a performance. It should feel like a calm control room for shared proxy infrastructure: clear state, measured controls, and exact consequences. The design earns trust through restraint, consistent structure, and a low-noise reading environment. The current visual system has a distinct purple and rose identity, large rounded surfaces, Geist typography, soft panels, and gentle motion. Future work should preserve that identity while making it more neutral: reduce decorative gradients, avoid glass as a default, and let color mark meaning, focus, or primary action.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral, readable surfaces with sparse orchid/violet brand accents.
Familiar product patterns: sidebar navigation, filters, tables, forms, dialogs only when necessary.
Precise labels, compact actions, and clear status vocabulary.
Gentle state motion that never delays the operator.

rules.name: The Accent Ration Rule
rules.body: Accent color should cover less than 10% of a normal product screen. If the page reads purple before it reads operational state, it is too loud.

rules.name: The No Pure Extremes Rule
rules.body: Never use pure black or pure white as a new design decision. Neutrals must stay slightly tinted toward the Rusuh palette.

rules.name: The Operator Type Rule
rules.body: Product text must stay readable at work speed. Do not introduce display fonts, ornamental headings, or oversized metric typography for routine dashboard information.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: If a border and a slight surface shift can separate content, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The No Decorative Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur and translucent panels must solve a layering problem. They are forbidden as default decoration.

dos: Do keep the product register visible: dashboard UI should serve workflows, not market itself.
Do use neutral tinted surfaces as the default, with Quiet Orchid reserved for primary actions, active navigation, focus, and rare identity moments.
Do pair every status color with text, labels, or icons so WCAG AA and color-blind use remain practical.
Do reuse existing shadcn/Radix primitives, Geist typography, CSS variables, and UI token helpers before creating new component vocabulary.
Do prefer inline/progressive management flows over modals unless focus trapping is necessary for safety.
donts: Don't make Rusuh look like a terminal-only hacker UI: no green-on-black intimidation, no dense faux-console chrome, no cyberpunk neon.
Don't use glow-heavy glassmorphism as default decoration. Glass is allowed only for real overlay layering.
Don't add side-stripe borders, gradient text, hero-metric templates, or identical card grids.
Don't flood inactive states with saturated purple, violet, or rose.
Don't use em dashes in interface copy or design documentation. Use commas, periods, colons, or parentheses.
